updates.note: Management reiterated the fresher hiring target for the full year at approximately 20,000.
updates.quote: For the full year, our target remains clear at approximately 20,000, so around 20,000 like last year.

updates.note: Revenue growth guidance for FY27 was revised down from 1.5% - 3% (previously reported in Q1 as 1.5% to 3.5%) to 1% to 2% YoY in constant currency terms.
updates.quote: Based on our Q2 performance and revised outlook for the rest of the year, our revenue growth guidance is 1% to 2% YoY.in constant currency terms.

updates.note: Operating margin guidance for the year was reiterated at 20% to 22%.
updates.quote: Our operating margin guidance remains at 20% to 22% for the year.

updates.note: Effective tax rate guidance for the year was reiterated in the range of 29% to 30%.
updates.quote: We expect effective tax rate for the year to be in the range of 29% to 30%.

updates.note: Target for FDEs over multiple years was reiterated.
updates.quote: What I think we had shared was the 6,000 was over the multiple years, and that is exactly how the planning is going right now.

new_promises.statement: The net new mega deal signed in Q2 is expected to contribute over 1% revenue growth in FY28.
new_promises.quote: This deal is expected to contribute over 1% revenue growth in the coming financial year.
new_promises.speaker: Salil Parekh
